[NLFC.8.2] **Clone requires a quiescent engine.**

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| `src` or `out_dst` NULL | `DS_ERR_INVAL` |
| called mid-pump / mid-callback | `DS_ERR_STATE`, as every call on that engine is ([RARC.13.16]); clone runs between pumps only |
| `src` has halted | `DS_ERR_ENGINE_HALTED`: a clone would carry the halted state into an engine with no halt ([NCBK.2.9]) |
| allocation fails | `DS_ERR_OOM` (source unchanged) |

Clone mints no new error codes; it reuses the existing taxonomy ([NLFC.7.4]).
This edition has no realtime entry point, so no engine an integrator holds is in
RT mode ([NRTM.9.1]).
